env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group-child send of a contextual shift into a channel whose element
# type embeds an interface through a type argument keeps the typed
# temporary: the spelling names the embedded interface, not the
# inherited methods, so checking the full method set rejects a valid
# spelling and the fallback defaults the shift to int. Without the
# snapshot the send rejects the value.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok sealed 4$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^ok sealed 4$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/groupsendsealed

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Sealed interface {
	hidden()
}
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"example.com/groupsendsealed/lib"
	"fmt"
)

type Word[T any] int8

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch := make(chan Word[interface{ lib.Sealed }], 1)
	var n uint = 2
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			ch <- 1 << n
		}
	}
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		fmt.Println("ok sealed", int8(v))
	case <-ctx.Done():
		fmt.Println("err: cancelled")
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
	}
}
